name: Ichiyanagi Bansai
source:
[SPOILER]Excelsius Winner was a successful former Chief Prosecutor who went on to head the Committee for Prosecutorial Excellence. He is also the father of the incompetent prosecutor [url=https://vndb.org/c19274]Eustace Winner[/url].

Excelsius abused his power to further various criminal activities and dispose of those who defied him. His actions had far-reaching consequences, especially for those affected by the IS-7, DL-6, and SS-5 Incidents.[/SPOILER]

[From [url=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Bansai_Ichiyanagi]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url]]
